acceptedAnswer.text: A cloud service that watches for a trigger — an email arrives, a record is created, a form is submitted — and runs a defined sequence of steps in response: approve, notify, update a record, generate a document. It replaces the manual 'someone checks the inbox and re-types it' step.

mainEntity.name: Does Power Automate replace our ERP or CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It connects to the systems you already run and moves data between them. Replacing a working ERP or CRM is rarely the fix — the manual steps around it usually are.

mainEntity.name: What happens when something goes wrong in an automated flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly built flow surfaces failures rather than failing silently — a named person is alerted in Teams or email with enough context to resolve it, and failures are logged for review.

acceptedAnswer.text: A platform for building custom business applications quickly, without a full software development project. Apps can run on a phone, tablet or browser, connect to Dataverse or your existing systems, and work offline where connectivity is unreliable.

mainEntity.name: Can Power Apps work without an internet connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for canvas apps built with offline capability in mind. Data is captured locally on the device and syncs automatically once a connection is available.

mainEntity.name: Do we need Dataverse to use Power Apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always — apps can connect to SharePoint, SQL or other data sources. We generally recommend Dataverse for anything beyond a simple app, because it gives proper data validation, relationships and security.

pageAudits.title: Power BI Reporting and Dashboards | Inturing

jsonLdBlocks.name: Inturing

acceptedAnswer.text: A tool for connecting to your operational data, modelling it once, and publishing dashboards and reports that refresh on a schedule. Done properly, it replaces manually assembled weekly reports with a live view everyone works from.

mainEntity.name: Why do two reports in our business show different numbers for the same thing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost always because each report is built from its own manual export with its own definition of the metric. A governed Power BI model fixes this by defining each measure once and reusing it everywhere.

mainEntity.name: How often can Power BI dashboards refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: From near real-time down to daily or weekly, depending on the data source and what the decision actually needs. We match refresh frequency to decision cadence, not the platform's maximum.

jsonLdBlocks.name: Inturing

acceptedAnswer.text: A low-code tool for building AI agents that can answer questions, look up information and take defined actions, using your own data sources rather than the open internet. It sits inside the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform governance model, so what the agent can access and do is explicitly controlled.

mainEntity.name: Does an agent built in Copilot Studio send our data to the public internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Agents are grounded in the data sources you connect — internal documents, Dataverse or line-of-business systems — within your organisation's existing Microsoft 365 security boundary.

mainEntity.name: What happens when the agent doesn't know the answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly scoped agent recognises low-confidence cases and hands off to a person rather than answering anyway. We design that handoff path as part of the build.
